summary: All-in-one doc platform combining documents, tables and automations (now under Superhuman Docs).
access_note: API is free in free and paid workspaces; a user-generated API token is sent as a Bearer header.

evidence.quote: The API token is invalid or has expired.
We make the Superhuman Docs API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces.
The Superhuman Docs API is a RESTful API that lets you programmatically interact with data in Superhuman Docs
Under the hood, Superhuman Docs runs an MCP server built on the open Model Context Protocol standard

notes: Coda is now Superhuman Docs. mcp_url https://coda.io/apis/mcp is the vendor's setup URL per search result of Coda's help article (help.coda.io is behind Cloudflare, so that page could not be fetched by script). Verified live: the URL returns 401 and /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/apis/mcp names it 'Superhuman Docs MCP Server'. A newer endpoint https://docs.superhuman.com/apis/mcp also answers with the same metadata. MCP auth is OAuth; the REST API uses API tokens only (no OAuth for third-party apps found), hence api_key.

review.reason: Official MCP exists (vendor guide and live OAuth metadata) but pass 1 left the URL empty, which the validator rejected.
Free self-serve API token and a moderate REST API; pass 1 blocker narrow_api contradicted its own api_breadth moderate.
